question: How many drones will Russia launch at Ukraine overnight on 26–27 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: November 2026 overnight Air Force totals (15 nights): 193,289,310,128,227,172,164,317,162,163,123,117,96,132,158; median 163, mean ~183. About 1 night in 5 is a mass strike near 290-320, and some 2026 combined strikes went past 450-600. The last six nights were quieter (96-163) amid the talks, but the PM projects ~6,500 jet Shaheds in November, implying big strikes ahead. A 26-27 Nov energy truce is unlikely (Manifold has energy ceasefire by 20 Nov at 6%, full ceasefire in 2026 at 4%; no market prices nightly counts). Right-skewed distribution centred near the November median.
calls.dossier:
- Air Force overnight drone-launch totals for November 2026 (UP, Ukrinform and Interfax-Ukraine reports): 1-2 Nov 193; 2-3 Nov 289; 3-4 Nov 310; 4-5 Nov 128 (+2 Kh-35); 5-6 Nov 227; 6-7 Nov 172 (combined strike, with missiles); 7-8 Nov 164; 8-9 Nov 317; 9-10 Nov 162 (+1 Iskander); 10-11 Nov 163; 11-12 Nov 123 (+ballistic/Zircon missiles); 12-13 Nov 117; 13-14 Nov 96; 14-15 Nov 132; 15-16 Nov 158 (77 jet-powered). Daytime waves are reported separately (e.g., 171 on 2 Nov, 62 on 3 Nov) and do not count.
- Summary statistics over those 15 nights: median 163, mean ~183, min 96, max 317; 3 of 15 nights >= 289; empirical 10th-90th ~105-312.
- Last six nights (10-16 Nov), during and after the Abu Dhabi talks: 96-163.
- UP 16 Nov 2026: PM Koretskyi says Russia may launch up to 6,500 jet-powered drones in November (12x August).
- Background: 2026 average ~200-220 UAVs/day (ISIS, includes daytime); three nights above 600 in April 2026; war record 810 (7 Sep 2025). Mass combined strikes on the grid recur roughly every 5-10 days.
- Status quo: continued nightly barrages, no energy truce. Manifold: Russian energy-ceasefire commitment by 20 Nov and full 2026 ceasefire both priced very low (no market on nightly counts found).
- Diplomacy: next trilateral round agreed but undated as of 13 Nov; Putin ruled out a ceasefire on 1 Oct 2026.
- Resolves off the Air Force overnight summary published the morning of 27 Nov (Kyiv time) as reported by UP/Ukrinform, drones only, missiles excluded; the overnight figure takes priority over any 24h figure.
- Event window: evening of 26 Nov -> morning of 27 Nov 2026 (Kyiv), per the summary's own stated period; as of 17 Nov 01:50 UTC, 0% elapsed (window not yet started).
- Searched but not found: any announced date for the next negotiation round; any market on nightly drone counts; the 16-17 Nov figure (not yet published at search time).

calls.reasoning: This rests on the Ukrainian Air Force's 14 nightly totals for Nov 2026: 96, 105, 117, 132, 149, 158, 162, 163, 164, 172, 193, 289, 310 and 317. That is a median of about 160 and a mean of about 180, with a two-part pattern: medium nights of 100-170 and a large energy strike of 290-320 every few days. The last four nights were quieter (96-158). The upper tail is widened because the Air Force spokesman warned on 16 Nov of a new energy strike, the PM projected 6,500 jet Shaheds for November, and retaliation for Ukraine's record 16 Nov strike on Russia is possible; 600+ nights are rare (April 2026). The lower tail allows a small chance of a truce from the talks. No market on nightly drone counts was found; Manifold ceasefire markets (4% for a 2026 ceasefire, 6% for an energy-ceasefire commitment before 20 Nov) are background only, not anchors.

calls.reasoning: Reference class: UAF overnight drone-launch totals for ~15 nights of Nov 2026 (median ~163, mean ~183), a mix of routine 100-200 nights and roughly one in five combined energy strikes of 290-320. The last six nights (96-163) were quieter during the talks, but the Air Force warned of a new energy strike, the PM projected ~6,500 jet Shaheds for November, and retaliation for Ukraine's record strike is possible, so the right tail is heavy. A truce by 26 Nov is very unlikely (Manifold ceasefire-related contracts at 4-6%, not matching this question; no market on nightly counts). Median near the November median, right-skewed, ~3% on >600.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the core November series and on the absence of any truce. Factual disputes: the 4-5 Nov figure (128 vs 105) cannot be settled without web access and barely matters, since both are low nights; the 11-12 Nov figure of 123 (Run 1 only) fits the quiet mid-November cluster and was kept. The judgment disputes were how much weight the six-night lull gets against the warnings of a new energy strike, and how heavy the tail is. I bet on a routine night with about a 20-25% chance of a 280+ mass strike and a 3% chance of going above 600. I carried forward the runs' reference class and a dispersion of about 235, in line with their 232-250.
